title: Invariant transitions replace equilibrium assumptions, not the need to mix
statement: For pi_t proportional to nu_s exp(tH), exact base sampling plus invariant intermediate kernels makes raw AIS weights unbiased without intermediate equilibrium. With h=B_range/L and spectral contraction gamma_j, the relative variance is bounded by e1^T T_L...T_1 e1-1, where T_j=[[1+sinh(h/2)^2,(exp(2h)-1)/2],[gamma_j(exp(h)-1)/2,gamma_j exp(3h/2)]]. The third power of incremental density ratio in the weighted-law recursion is essential. Positive weighted quadrature inherits the worst-node relative variance without dividing statistical confidence by node count; numerical failures still sum over all draws. With L_i^2=beta(S_ii+B_ii), Tstar=sum L_i^2, Lstar^2=max L_i^2 and B_norm>=sup||a||^2/2, Cstar=4alpha B_norm+(2Lstar^2+alpha)Tstar bounds conditional energy variance and Var_pi_t H<=Cstar/(1-t alpha). At fixed physical bounds/margin Cstar=O(n), allowing O(n) stages and O(Q n eta^-2 log(1/zeta)) transitions. The completed small run uses the older range-matrix certificate because extensive constants are worse there. Identity-kernel AIS always has weight exp(H(X0)); grid refinement alone cannot reduce variance. Approximate reverse conditionals need field-reached error accounting and can spoil unbiasedness.

requires: Acquired J=D0+S+AA^T, S PSD with norm<=kappa, B=AA^T of controlled rank r and norm<=Lambda, actual beta/fields/rates/mesh M, susceptibility chi_M and first omitted collective frequency Omega. Strict alpha=kappa chi_M+4 Lambda/Omega<1, uniformly in every longitudinal field.

Exact or budgeted positive one-spin cyclic transfer evaluation and sampling, independent uniform-word and arithmetic contract, exact support/zero handling. Whole spin paths are conditionally independent only after Gaussian conditioning.

Thermal preparation requires compatible pins, potential-outside symmetric product, a genuine fixed random tape simultaneously good for all coherent prefixes, amplified statistical AND numerical precision, reversible counting and actual gates.

assumptions: Completed P3 visible-only mathematical final and source-reported classical execution. Referenced attachments were NOT acquired; no upload, export, repackaging or alternate transfer. Raw page/UI/sidebar capture is private. Actual public Gaussian and Alternatives shared-context reviews are carried only at their stated scopes, not blind independence or a whole-architecture audit. Known Gaussian augmentation and pinned thermal-preparation architecture retain their primary ancestry. The completed 12-spin full high-frequency run is separate from the preceding 64-spin two-bin computation. Conditional confidence requires independent uniform words and the exact arithmetic contract; seeded pseudorandom reproducibility is not a proof of independence. Full spectral comparison wins. General high-precision pinned counter, broader native implementation and reversible quantum circuit remain unbuilt; no generic speedup, device or practical advantage.
costs: Dense sweep costs O(n(q+r)M+rM log M), q=rank S; mesh-independent sweep contraction is not mesh-independent arithmetic. All spatial factors, Gaussian coordinates, temporal transforms, transfers, retained quadrature nodes and actual finite-bit work remain paid.

Acquisition is reused, pinned normalizers are separate full computations. Fixed temperature, physical bounds, retained dimension and positive contraction margin are needed for polynomial asymptotics; cooling can enlarge the difficult sector.

Completed main run: 33,200 trajectories, 16,965,200 sweeps, 6,527,385,600 binary spin-time draws, 7,057,523,200 Gaussian scalars, 13,584,908,800 uniform52 words, 450.551966 s on two CPU threads. Full ledger includes failed/preliminary work and unknown early timings.
